sections.section_title: RAMCFG BKPSRAM double error address register (RAMCFG_BKPSRAMEDEAR)
sections.text_helper: Section 10.6.15 "RAMCFG BKPSRAM double error address register (RAMCFG_BKPSRAMEDEAR)" in chapter 10 (SRAM configuration controller (RAMCFG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 302.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x490
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Reset on any system reset.
Bits 31:11 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 10:0 EDEA[10:0]: ECC double error address
When ALE is set in RAMCFG_BKPSRAMCR, this field is updated with the word address
corresponding to the ECC double error.
